name: ponytail
description: Lazy senior dev mode: the smallest change that fully solves the task. YAGNI, stdlib first, one line over fifty. Six skills and slash commands for lazy coding, diff review, whole-repo audit, shortcut-debt ledger, and measured impact. Port of DietrichGebert/ponytail (MIT).

description_i18n.en: Lazy senior dev mode: the smallest change that fully solves the task. YAGNI, stdlib first, one line over fifty. Six skills and slash commands for lazy coding, diff review, whole-repo audit, shortcut-debt ledger, and measured impact. Port of DietrichGebert/ponytail (MIT).
description_i18n.zh-CN: 懒惰资深开发模式：用完全解决问题的最小变更。YAGNI、优先标准库、能一行就不写五十行。包含懒人编码、变更审查、全仓库审计、技术债台账、实测收益六组技能与斜杠命令。移植自 DietrichGebert/ponytail（MIT）。
